name: Vietnam Morning Brief
description: Personal-pilot morning brief that reads a small set of publisher-provided RSS feeds, keeps original source links, and sends a concise Vietnamese digest to Telegram with optional AI summarization.

config_schema.label: Telegram chat ID
config_schema.description: Chat, group, or channel that should receive the morning brief.

config_schema.label: AI summarization
config_schema.description: Optional. Keep this at none for the first run; OpenAI or DeepSeek can later select and summarize notable stories.

credential_requirements.label: Telegram bot token
credential_requirements.description: Required. Encrypted bot token used only by the local Goflow runtime to deliver the brief.

credential_requirements.label: OpenAI API key (optional)
credential_requirements.description: Optional; used only when AI summarization is set to openai.

credential_requirements.label: DeepSeek API key (optional)
credential_requirements.description: Optional; used only when AI summarization is set to deepseek.
